datasets.title: Central African Republic Airports (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['aeroway'] IS NOT NULL OR tags['building'] = 'aerodrome' OR tags['emergency:helipad'] IS NOT NULL OR tags['emergency'] = 'landing_site' Features may have these attributes: name name:en aeroway building emergency emergency:helipad operator:type capacity:persons addr:full addr:city source name:fr name:sg This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_caf_airports]
datasets.details: OpenStreetMap data is crowd sourced and cannot be considered to be exhaustive

lineage.description: OpenStreetMap features matching aeroway tags, aerodrome buildings, emergency helipads, and landing sites were extracted and exported by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) for Central African Republic. The dataset provides multi-format geospatial representations (points, lines, polygons) of aviation infrastructure with attributes including facility names, operators, and capacity information.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap contributors
sources.description: Volunteered geographic information (VGI) providing spatial locations and attributes of aeroway features, buildings classified as aerodromes, emergency helipads, and landing sites across Central African Republic
